title: O12 display/renderer relaunch regression against the O14 InputContract
result: PASS (display lifecycle); GAP DOCUMENTED (input across generations)

commands.run_o12_relaunch: adb -s emulator-5556 shell am instrument -w -e class com.pocketrealm.o12.O12IntegratedRuntimeTest#rendererShareContextSurvivesRepeatedClientLaunches -e o12RendererLaunchCycles 2 com.pocketrealm.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
commands.run_o13_smoke_prerequisite: adb -s emulator-5556 shell am instrument -w -e class com.pocketrealm.o13.O13BotTierTest -e o13SoakSeconds 60 com.pocketrealm.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
commands.run_o13_smoke_result: OK (1 test) — Time: 89.076s (recovered the dirty-stop DB state the earlier interrupted O12 run left, restoring the realm stack to a clean-startable condition without restoring or clearing data)

display_lifecycle_evidence.note: Each cycle creates a fresh ClientDisplayHost (= a fresh InputContract generation), recreates the EGL renderer surface, launches the Wine self-test client, waits for non-black output, and stops cleanly. This proves the O14 InputContract does not regress the verified O12 EGL share-context / renderer-recreation lifecycle.

completion_audit_against_objective_requi.two_fresh_display_client_generations: PASS — 2 cycles, each a fresh ClientDisplayHost/generation
completion_audit_against_objective_requi.clean_final_client_shutdown: PASS — clean stop asserted each cycle
completion_audit_against_objective_requi.keyboard_absolute_pointer_left_click_obs: NOT COVERED by this test — the O12 relaunch test checks rendering only, not input delivery per cycle. Input delivery after a single launch is covered by O14InputContractTest (PASS) and ClientRuntimeLifecycleTest (PASS). Input delivery specifically across a host replacement is not covered by any existing checked-in test.
completion_audit_against_objective_requi.held_input_released_during_teardown: NOT COVERED across relaunch by this test. Release-all on focus loss / pause / close for a single generation is covered by O14InputContractTest (PASS, lastReleaseReason=FOCUS_LOSS, 1 button + 1 key released).
completion_audit_against_objective_requi.stale_prior_generation_input_rejected: NOT COVERED across relaunch by this test. Stale-generation rejection within a single host is covered by O14InputContractTest (PASS, rejectedStaleEventCount=1). Cross-generation stale rejection is not directly tested, though the InputContract's generation field is sourced from ClientDisplayHost (each host = unique generation), so a stale event from a prior host's generation is rejected by the new host's contract.

test_infrastructure_gap.gap: No existing checked-in test exercises keyboard/pointer delivery, held-input release, AND stale-generation rejection specifically across a ClientDisplayHost replacement (host tear-down + fresh host + new generation + input on the new host + stale event from the old host rejected). The O12 relaunch test covers display lifecycle only; the O14/O06 tests cover input on a single host only.
test_infrastructure_gap.preference_path_taken: Option 1 (existing O12 relaunch test) was run and passed for display lifecycle. Option 2 (self-test client with repeated fresh host generations) is the correct next step for the input-across-generations coverage but is not implemented per the objective's 'propose without implementing' instruction.
test_infrastructure_gap.proposed_minimal_test: O14InputContractRelaunchTest: launch the self-test client through a ClientDisplayHost (generation N), inject keyboard+pointer+left-click, hold a button+key, tear down the host (onPause/close), create a fresh ClientDisplayHost (generation N+1), relaunch the self-test client, inject keyboard+pointer+left-click on the new host, attempt a stale event stamped with generation N (rejected), verify held input from generation N was released during teardown, verify non-black output after relaunch, clean shutdown. This reuses the existing O14InputContractTest harness (self-test client, dispatchKey/Pointer/RightButton, inputDiagnostics) across two host instances. No changes to InputContract, ClientDisplayHost, or the Win32 probe are needed — the test drives only public APIs already present at commit 40bdcb3.

remaining_gaps_after_this_regression: Input delivery (keyboard/pointer/click) across a ClientDisplayHost replacement is not directly tested (test-infrastructure gap documented above).
O14 remains pending: IME, gamepad, pointer capture, profile persistence, touch overlay not implemented; UX-T01 through UX-T08 NOT complete.
